title: Bond order of F₂
statement:
What is the bond order of neutral F₂ in the introductory valence MO diagram?

[_]{a}

explanations: This would omit two antibonding electrons.
This would require two more antibonding electrons.
This resembles neutral N₂ rather than F₂.

hints: The late-family diagram fills the bonding set and makes π* fully occupied.
There are eight bonding and six antibonding electrons.
solution: Count fourteen valence electrons. The late-family diagram fills the bonding set and makes π* fully occupied. There are eight bonding and six antibonding electrons. (8−6)/2=1.
